probe_assessment: The cold read mostly held up. The purpose and nearly all public API roles match the module. One material omission is that assemble_contacts applies wrist gating and suppression only when sticky_distances is supplied; its no-sticky branch returns every raw candidate with blank gate fields. Two listed stumbles are genuine file-local limits: the TODO invokes unexplained historical close-up and standing-count semantics, and build_sticky_result relies on the imported sticky_anchor result contract and EMA parameters. The impulse multiple's empirical provenance cannot be checked from this file, but its operational rule and default are explicit, so that is not a comprehension finding. The duplicate serve_setup_still entry is probe bookkeeping rather than a code finding.

probe_findings.claim: The public_api description of assemble_contacts implies that every call performs wrist gating and suppression, but the no-sticky branch returns all raw flags and leaves both gate fields blank; those stages are conditional on sticky_distances.
The serve-start lane's intended close-up semantics cannot be settled from this file: the TODO invokes prior size-banded behaviour and an implied position/count contract that is not defined here.
